stage_progress.title: Discovery and search product shell
goals: align homepage discovery and search results with the approved search-first information hierarchy
preserve canonical search URL, filter and ranking ownership while making entity context and provenance legible
improve empty, partial and degraded public states without inventing results or ranking evidence
preserve desktop and mobile visual-review screenshots through the existing browser-smoke owner

stage_progress.title: Canonical entity detail experience
goals: refine canonical entity detail around shared identity, facts, relationships, provenance and provider destinations
preserve stable canonical URLs, metadata ownership and provider-neutral identity

stage_progress.title: Persisted chart and provenance UX
goals: present persisted chart observations with metric semantics, provenance and freshness
distinguish unavailable evidence from valid zero or empty chart state

stage_progress.title: Mobile, accessibility, performance and stage closure
goals: normalize responsive public behavior and WCAG 2.2 AA-sensitive interactions
protect server-rendered primary metadata and close Stage 23 through exact-head repository verification

work_lease_policy.authority: live Git branch + GitHub pull request
work_lease_policy.rule: Never store volatile PR/head state as authored progress. AI must resolve the live branch/PR before writing; an existing active PR for the same semantic owner is resumed instead of duplicated. Stage work uses one umbrella branch while logical tranche ownership remains explicit in this plan.
